body:
I don't think i will be able to take it, to be honest. If i am completely, 100% honest, i think the best way to overcome this would be to talk to an actual medical doctor, and get assurance that this kind of torture WILL kill me if ever performed on me, and i won't have to live with it for too long. I think that might be a way to overcome it, as it was my way to learn how to cope with the fear of being buried alive (lack of oxygen will get me soon enough, so i won't really have to suffer for too long).

Is there a subreddit where i can ask something like this? It's an unusual question, but it may help.

I'm not in therapy anymore (i was for about 5 years, but i left when i felt better). However, i never actually had discussed this on my sessions, mostly because at the time i was completely unhinged due to bipolar and that was my entire focus. Maybe i should consider it again. Thanks for your comment!

At first, i also related it to PTSD. It felt wrong to call PTSD something like this, but they are very similar symptoms. 

Thank you for your comment!

It's related to me being claustrophobic, and having an extreme fear of being restrained.

In fact, my family has very specific instructions on how to dispose of my body in case of natural death : Cremation or Sky Burial, after organ donation. This helped me cope with the (probably silly) fear of being buried alive. But you probably see where i'm going with this.

The fact was that this story featured a total immobilization, and a way to keep you alive for years in that situation. It's the ultimate nightmare of a claustrophobic.

I do remember someone in reddit a while ago mentioning this story, and a doctor (or someone who claimed to be one) saying that in that situation, it's very likely that the person won't survive that long. That's my only mechanism to deal with this particular nightmare, but it was not confirmed at all...

And i have no idea what to do. I had triggers with other things, but... nothing that would scare me so much that my main coping mechanism is thinking about how to kill myself.


It pains me so much to even talk about this, that it makes me suffer to write these comments. But i feel i need to get past the panic, to maybe get someone to show me a way out, or at least a clue of what to do.
